# Kaptiono

> Kaptiono is an AI subtitle tool for creators. It can generate, edit, style and export captions using Local Whisper models in the browser or an optional Cloud High Accuracy transcription mode.

The original video stays on the user's device. Local models process audio on-device. When Cloud High Accuracy is selected, only the extracted audio required for transcription is sent to the Kaptiono cloud transcription service. Kaptiono is designed for creator workflows such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and long-form video, with no-watermark export options.

## Product

- [Kaptiono](https://kaptiono.com/): Main web application for AI subtitle generation, editing, styling and export.

- [Terms of Use](https://kaptiono.com/terms/): Terms governing use of the Kaptiono web application and AI-generated captions.
